meta.title: DeepSeek Chat
meta.description: A two-way bridge between DeepSeek desktop conversations and chat.deepseek.com: three chat entries (sidebar, header tab, right-sidebar card) plus an optional conditional auto-loop that transfers a finished desktop answer to the web page, grabs the web reply and writes it only into the desktop draft (never auto-executed). Adds cross-session isolation, status-bar manual bind and settings gear, session titles, three safety valves, and a settings page with check-for-updates and one-click update.
